content.text:
I changed `SIGNATURE_THRESHOLD_CENTS` in `lib/labels.js:5` from `100_000` to `30_000`. The constant is in cents, so that's €1000 down to €300. All 30 tests pass.

The check is still strictly greater than the threshold. A parcel declared at exactly €300 doesn't need a signature, and anything above does. That matches your insurer's wording of "more than 300 euros".

The existing signature test builds its values from the constant, so it didn't need changing. Nothing else in the repo refers to the old value.
